frozen_fields: all edge features, transforms, model cells, regularization and calibration
all label horizon, purge and embargo rules
all exits, stops and profit protection
all fee, funding, spread, slippage, impact and latency assumptions
all sizing, portfolio limits and promotion gates

time_windows.final_oos_window_change: A change to either final-OOS boundary requires a new experiment ID; a failed capture cannot move the start date.

decision_clock.signal_bar: The current 4h bar must be complete at signalTime = closeTime.
decision_clock.decision_time: decisionTime is set only after the completed bar, point-in-time universe, depth book, funding inputs and exchange filters have all been received and validated.
decision_clock.future_data_rule: Every event timestamp and local receipt timestamp must be <= decisionTime; future or missing receipt timestamps invalidate the candidate.

universe.depth_measure: minimum of bid and ask quote notional within 10 bps of mid from the reconstructed full L2 book
universe.missing_data_policy: Missing, stale, crossed or sequence-invalid depth excludes the symbol and never falls back to bookTicker or OHLCV proxy.

regime.sma_input: completed 4h close prices including the current completed bar
regime.bull_formula: BTC fastSMA > BTC slowSMA AND BTC close > BTC slowSMA AND count(eligible symbols with close > own slowSMA) >= ceil(0.5 * eligible universe size)
regime.bear_formula: BTC fastSMA < BTC slowSMA AND BTC close < BTC slowSMA AND count(eligible symbols with close < own slowSMA) >= ceil(0.5 * eligible universe size)
regime.sideways_formula: Any state not satisfying the complete bull or bear formula, including insufficient universe size, is SIDEWAYS.

candidate.engine: Candidate -> Edge Model -> Net Edge Gate -> Portfolio Risk Gate -> Advisory
candidate.channel_window: The prior 120 completed bars immediately before the signal bar; the signal bar is excluded.
candidate.breakout_distance_role: Feature metadata only; it is never expectedPriceEdgeBps and never a direct PnL estimate.
candidate.candidate_decision: A Candidate contains no TRADE decision and cannot bypass Edge, Net Edge or Portfolio Risk gates.
candidate.entry_price: The first fillable full-L2 executable book at or after decisionTime; theoretical bar open is not an entry price.

edge_model.output_units: basis points of executable price return before fee and funding
edge_model.model_cell_rule: Fit one separate model per candidate cell. BUY/BULL and SELL/BEAR observations are never pooled, and there is no pooled-mean or breakout-distance fallback.
edge_model.insufficient_sample_action: edge.available=false; decision=NO_TRADE; no substitute estimate is permitted.

label.entry_observation: First fillable full-L2 executable entry VWAP at or after decisionTime and no later than max_signal_to_entry_latency_ms.
label.exit_observation: First fillable opposite-side executable exit VWAP at or after entryTime + 6 * bar_interval_ms and no later than one bar after the target.
label.formula: sideSign * (exitVWAP / entryVWAP - 1) * 10000, where BUY=+1 and SELL=-1
label.invalid_label_policy: Missing, stale, unfillable, crossed or sequence-invalid target book produces no label and is recorded as data failure, not as zero return.

purge_and_embargo.purge_rule: For a prediction at decisionTime t, a training label is eligible only when labelExitTime <= t - purge_bars * bar_interval_ms.
purge_and_embargo.embargo_rule: For each walk-forward split cutoff C, validation candidates begin at C + embargo_bars * bar_interval_ms; observations in the embargo interval are excluded from both fitting and validation.
purge_and_embargo.oos_training_rule: The model is frozen at development_end_exclusive_utc. Final-OOS labels never enter the final-OOS edge estimate.

features.atr_bps: clip(ATR30 / signalClose * 10000, 0, 5000), with true range using prior completed close
features.breadth_fraction: count(eligible symbols on the regime side) / eligible_universe_size
features.funding_carry_bps: clip(-sideSign * sum of the last three settled funding rates known at decisionTime * 10000, -50, 50)

feature_transform.winsorization: For each feature and cell, clip to the linearly interpolated training-only p01 and p99 quantiles.
feature_transform.standardization: After winsorization, subtract the training-only mean and divide by training-only population standard deviation; a zero standard deviation uses scale=1 and remains a valid constant feature.
feature_transform.fit_data_only: All quantiles, means and scales are calculated using eligible training rows before the prediction timestamp.
feature_transform.intercept: Add one unscaled intercept column after standardization.

training_method.method: Expanding walk-forward ridge regression separately for each candidate cell
training_method.refit_frequency: Every candidate decision after minimum_samples_per_cell is reached
training_method.objective: minimize sum((y - intercept - X * beta)^2) + 10 * sum(beta^2); intercept is not penalized
training_method.solver: Deterministic double-precision Cholesky on the augmented normal equations; non-positive-definite or non-finite solve invalidates the candidate and does not trigger a fallback.
training_method.candidate_level_prediction: expectedPriceEdgeBps = calibrated intercept + calibrated standardized feature vector dot cell-specific coefficients; two candidates with different features may receive different predictions.

uncertainty_and_calibration.residual_variance: sigma2 = SSE / (n - effectiveDegreesOfFreedom), where effectiveDegreesOfFreedom = trace(X * inverse(X'X + lambda I) * X') and the intercept is included but not regularized.
uncertainty_and_calibration.standard_error_bps: sqrt(sigma2 * (1 + x' * inverse(X'X + lambda I) * x))
uncertainty_and_calibration.oof_predictions: Generate chronological out-of-fold predictions using only data eligible before each prediction; never score a row with a model trained on its label.
uncertainty_and_calibration.calibration_fit: When at least 100 OOF rows exist in a cell, fit y = a + b * rawPrediction by ridge with lambda=1, unpenalized intercept, and clamp b to [0.25, 4].
uncertainty_and_calibration.conformal_residual: q90 of absolute OOF residuals using the linearly interpolated empirical 90th percentile; q90 is calculated per cell and requires minimum_calibration_samples.
uncertainty_and_calibration.trade_uncertainty_rule: If calibration or uncertainty is unavailable, edge.available=false and the candidate cannot become an Advisory.

required_calibration_report.predicted_vs_realized: mean predicted edge, mean realized forward return and mean signed error
required_calibration_report.mae: mean absolute realized forward return minus predicted edge
required_calibration_report.rmse: sqrt(mean squared realized forward return minus predicted edge)
required_calibration_report.deciles: Sort by predicted edge with stable (signalTime, symbol) tie break and assign D1-D10 by floor(rank * 10 / n) + 1; report count and mean predicted/realized/error per decile.
required_calibration_report.rank_correlation: Spearman correlation using average ranks for ties; a zero-variance series is uncalibrated, not correlation zero.
required_calibration_report.primary_objective: Net expectancy and robustness; win rate is supplementary only.

dynamic_channel.window: Prior 60 completed bars excluding the current bar
dynamic_channel.long_formula: Exit when a completed close is strictly below min(low[i-60], ..., low[i-1])
dynamic_channel.short_formula: Exit when a completed close is strictly above max(high[i-60], ..., high[i-1])

atr_stop.atr_definition: Simple mean of the last 30 true ranges known at the completed signal bar
atr_stop.trigger: First executable opposite-side book crossing the stop price

profit_protection.high_water_mark: Best reconstructed executable mid after entry; update only with received, sequence-valid L2 events.
profit_protection.long_formula: After activation, trailingStop = max(previousTrailingStop, highWaterMark - entryATR)
profit_protection.short_formula: After activation, trailingStop = min(previousTrailingStop, lowWaterMark + entryATR)
profit_protection.trigger: First executable opposite-side book crossing the ratcheted trailing stop

exit_model.same_timestamp_rule: If a stop and channel event share a timestamp, the stop is selected by the frozen priority. If event order cannot be proven from received L2 timestamps, the position is marked invalid and excluded from promotion metrics.
exit_model.terminal_exit: Close any still-open paper position at the first valid executable book at final_oos_end_exclusive_utc; terminal exit is not a 24-hour forced close and is separate from the edge research horizon.
exit_model.counterfactual_rule: Alternative exits may be logged as exploratory diagnostics only and cannot change this exit model or any OOS result.

execution_cost_model.book_type: full reconstructed L2, up to 1000 price levels per side
execution_cost_model.fill_method: walk the adverse side of the book for the requested quantity; VWAP is the executable price
execution_cost_model.observed_book_cost: entry adverse VWAP cost plus exit adverse VWAP cost relative to each contemporaneous mid

funding.source: official settled funding rows with markPrice and eventTime
funding.expected_funding_bps: -sideSign * sum of all settled funding rates expected during the holding period * 10000
funding.realized_accounting: Use every funding event from entryTime through exitTime inclusive with the causal mark price; missing event or mark invalidates the trade.

execution_cost_model.conservative_net_edge_formula: expectedPriceEdgeBps + expectedFundingBps - roundTripFeeBps - stressedBookCost - roundTripImpactBufferBps - roundTripLatencyBufferBps - 1.645 * uncertaintyPenaltyBps - fundingStressBps

gate.decision: Only a candidate passing all cost, uncertainty, data-age and fillability conditions can become a PAPER Advisory.

position_sizing.sizing_formula: quantity = floorToExchangeStep(min(equity * riskFraction / stopDistanceFraction, maximumPositionNotional, equity * maximumGrossLeverage) / executableEntryPrice)
position_sizing.exchange_filters: Use only point-in-time exchangeInfo quantity step, price tick and minimum notional; missing filters invalidate the candidate.
position_sizing.rounding: Round quantity down to the point-in-time exchange step; never round up.

portfolio_limits.risk_action: Any portfolio limit failure is NO_TRADE; do not lower limits to increase candidate count.

validation.method: Expanding walk-forward with six-bar purge and six-bar embargo
validation.development_uses: Only the development window, including 0019's downgraded OOS interval as development information; it is not an independent OOS claim.
validation.final_oos_uses: Only the separately locked 2026-09-01 through 2027-03-01 window after development gates pass; no early read and no start-date shift.
validation.counterfactuals: Exploratory only, excluded from all gates and all OOS result files.

development_gates.gate_evaluation: All gates are conjunctive; no gate may be waived or optimized after observing results.

stop_rules.development_fail: If any development gate fails, STOP immediately and do not read, consume or optimize against final OOS.
stop_rules.data_fail: If any required historical L2 field, level, receipt timestamp, update sequence, funding row, symbol interval or provenance hash is missing, status=DATA_FAIL and STOP.
stop_rules.no_degradation: bookTicker, OHLCV depth proxy, spread-only data, synthetic depth, missing sequence repair, or silent interval changes cannot satisfy any gate.
stop_rules.no_result_on_fail: A failed feasibility or development phase produces no 0020 result.json, trades.jsonl or PnL artifact.
stop_rules.final_oos_boundary: The final OOS window is immutable in this experiment; any requested change creates a new experiment ID.

depth_capture.historical_source_requirement: A licensed historical full L2 source is required for the development window; Binance official endpoints below are the real-time capture path for final OOS.
depth_capture.alignment: Buffer raw diff events; discard events with u < snapshot.lastUpdateId; first applied event must satisfy U <= lastUpdateId <= u.
depth_capture.sequence_rule: Every later applied event must satisfy pu == previous u; any gap, duplicate, out-of-order or crossed book restarts alignment and marks the segment invalid.
depth_capture.quantity_rule: Depth quantities are absolute; quantity zero removes a price level.
depth_capture.reconnect_rule: Reopen each WebSocket segment before 23 hours, overlap the new raw stream, fetch a new REST snapshot, and hash every segment independently.
depth_capture.storage: Write raw WebSocket NDJSON, raw REST snapshot NDJSON, funding NDJSON and a write-once manifest; store bytes, event/receipt timestamps, snapshot lastUpdateId and SHA-256 for every file.
depth_capture.completeness: A symbol segment is valid only with a snapshot, a contiguous applied sequence, two-sided non-crossed book and zero missing intervals; any failure is DATA_FAIL.
depth_capture.deployment: Capture plan only; no Production deployment and no order endpoint.
